bio.text: Maura Hirschauer has represented the 49th District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2021.
Hirschauer is a teacher with a B.A. in English from Colby College and has pursued graduate studies in elementary education at the University of Colorado Denver.
The legislature biography lists Hirschauer as a former president of the Batavia Mothers' Club Foundation.
